audience: clinics in Brazil that run their unit agenda and bookings in ERClinic

useCases.title: Plan the agenda by unit and professional
useCases.text: List the clinic's units and professionals. Then list the appointments of a date range to see what is booked.

useCases.title: Find the first open time for a visit
useCases.text: List the dates that have open agenda slots, then the times of one date. Insurance and specialty filters need a professional id.

useCases.title: Book an appointment at an open time
useCases.text: Book a new appointment in the clinic agenda. The booking is real: patients and staff see it. Check the time first.

useCases.title: Confirm or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: Set an appointment to confirmed, or cancel it so the slot can be booked again. Repeating a confirm leaves the appointment confirmed.

useCases.title: Check procedures and insurance plans
useCases.text: List the active procedures of a professional, with their preparation text. List the insurance plans the clinic accepts.
